answer: Each agent stakes a bond tied to a verifiable hardware falcon token, and every epoch a randomized pulse challenge forces it to prove liveness by signing a fresh nonce. Sybils must replicate hardware and stake per identity, so forging N identities costs N bonds plus N devices, while honest agents pay once. An oasis of trust emerges because peers only attest agents whose pulse history and stake survive challenge, making inexpensive mass registration economically irrational.
